summary: Sylvia Pfeiffer Williams describes BDS targeting Israeli government policies as a good nonviolent option and supports classroom criticism of those policies, yet she regrets a prior OEA resolution condemning Israel's disproportionate response for omitting acknowledgment of Israeli victims and hostages. On education, she favors a dialogue approach preserving multiple perspectives rather than making an explicit AB 715 implementation pledge. All responses come from a questionnaire uploaded 2026-09-09; the actual response date is not stated.
